function: Estimates near-field wideband XL-MIMO uplink channels by recovering sparse polar-domain vectors of all subcarriers with a deep-unfolded Joint LISTA-CP network (p. 5-6).
system: Uplink OFDM XL-MIMO: BS ULA with 256 antennas and 8 RF chains, single-antenna users, THz 100 GHz carrier, 10 GHz bandwidth, no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: Deep unfolding: Joint LISTA-CP, M parallel LISTA-CP subnetworks with multidimensional shrinkage thresholding; supervised MSE training with Adam (p. 5-6).
data_channel: Custom Saleh-Valenzuela near-field wideband simulation, 3 clusters of 10 subpaths; second model (46) from [28]; all training and test data simulated (p. 3, 8, 9, 11).
test_conditions: Simulated training and test sets; NMSE swept over SNR, pilots, bandwidth and antennas; model (46) with same training setup; generalization left to future work (p. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: P-SOMP [3], P-SBL [40]. Learned: P-SBL-DU [36], LISTA-CP [41]; ISTA and LISTA also in the Gaussian-matrix tests (p. 9).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR, pilots, bandwidth, antennas and network layers; theoretical linear convergence error bound (p. 7-11).
complexity: Per-iteration orders: O(MGPN_RF) for Joint LISTA-CP, LISTA-CP, P-SBL; O(NcNpMGPN_RF) P-SOMP; O(MGPN_RF + 800MG) P-SBL-DU; no runtime or parameter count (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "the training and testing datasets used for network training are obtained through simulation"; the channel is a custom Saleh-Valenzuela near-field model (p. 3) or model (46) from [28] (p. 11), with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "Generalization is an additional technical aspect that can be further explored and improved in future work"; Figs. 7-10 sweep SNR, pilots, bandwidth and antennas, and model (46) uses the same training setup, with no trained model stated to be tested on unseen conditions.
q3_support: p. 9: "P-SOMP [3]: The polar domain-based SOMP" and "P-SBL-DU [36]: It is a deep unfolding version of the P-SBL"; Figs. 7-10 compare P-SOMP, P-SBL, P-SBL-DU and LISTA-CP with the proposed network on NMSE.
q4_support: p. 9: "The computational complexity of Joint LISTA-CP mainly arises from the matrix multiplication operations", with order O(MGPN_RF) per iteration, and orders for P-SOMP and P-SBL-DU.
q5_support: p. 8: "the training and testing datasets used for network training are obtained through simulation"; no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset appears in the 13 pages.
notes: Area 2: channel estimation by sparse recovery in the polar domain. Figs. 5-6 use a random Gaussian sensing matrix, not a channel (p. 8-9). Fig. 11 claims robustness across channel models but says the training setup is the same, and no train-on-one, test-on-other protocol is stated (p. 11). RIS appears only in related work (p. 2). Baselines [3] and [36] are earlier published methods.
